signature: _update_specs_for_intent(proj_dir: str, work_dir: str, developer_intent: str, changed_functions: dict, relevant_rel_files: list[str], extra_call_edges=None) -> list[str]
pre_condition: proj_dir is an existing directory that is a valid project root. work_dir is an existing directory containing an extracted_functions/ subdirectory with extracted function source files and their .spec.json/.info.json sidecar metadata. developer_intent is a non-empty string expressing the modification purpose whose behavioral implications must be reflected in the specs. changed_functions is a dict whose keys are file-system paths and whose values contain a classification field; only entries whose classification is 'added' or 'modified' serve as seed functions. relevant_rel_files is a list of path strings relative to the extracted_functions/ directory, each identifying an extracted-function file that is deemed relevant to developer_intent. extra_call_edges, when provided, is a list of supplemental call-graph edge records. At least one of changed_functions or relevant_rel_files must contribute at least one candidate function, or the no-op early-return is taken.
post_condition: Returns a sorted list of path strings that are relative to work_dir/extracted_functions/. Each returned path belongs to an extracted-function file whose .spec.json, .info.json, or both were created, updated, or rewritten during this call. For every function that is either a seed function (added/modified from changed_functions, or referenced in relevant_rel_files) or a reachable downstream callee of a function whose .info.json expectations changed, its .spec.json and .info.json sidecars are processed: if no sidecar pair exists, a new pair is generated defining the intended behavioral contract per developer_intent; if a pair already exists, it is evaluated against developer_intent and rewritten only when the evaluation determines a change is warranted. Processing order respects caller-before-callee dependency (top-down layering). Within a single round, functions that share no caller-callee relation are processed concurrently; functions in a caller-callee chain are deferred to separate rounds. After every round that produces spec updates, each caller of any updated function has its .info.json reconciled so its recorded callee expectations become consistent with the callee's new specification; reconciliations targeting distinct caller files run concurrently. If writing a sidecar pair produces a result that fails file-readiness validation, the write is rolled back to the pre-write contents and that function's sidecars are left unchanged. Original function source files are never modified. When the seed set is empty (no changed/modified function and no relevant rel file), returns an empty list with no modification to any file and without invoking any LLM.
